mapper.sql: left join lateral (select a.ack_id, a.ack_seq, a.ack_status, a.ack_on from srm_po_ack a where a.po_id = p.po_id and a.rev = p.rev order by a.ack_seq desc limit 1) va on true

p.po_id, p.po_no, p.rev, p.po_date, p.status, p.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm, p.currency_cd, trim_scale(p.total_amt)::text as total_amt, p.issued_at, (select count(*) from srm_po_line l where l.po_id = p.po_id)::int as line_cnt, va.ack_seq, va.ack_status, va.ack_on, (p.issued_at at time zone #{zone})::date + #{dueDays} as ack_due_date, p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED') as ackable
mapper.select:
select from srm_po p left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = p.plant_cd
where p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.issued_at is not null and p.po_date between #{from} and #{to} and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and p.po_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' order by p.po_date desc, p.po_id desc limit 500

select from srm_po p left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = p.plant_cd
where p.po_id = #{poId} and p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.issued_at is not null

select l.po_line_id, l.line_no, i.item_cd, l.item_nm, l.supplier_item_cd, l.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, trim_scale(l.cancel_qty)::text as cancel_qty, trim_scale(l.recv_qty)::text as recv_qty, trim_scale(greatest(l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty, 0))::text as open_qty, trim_scale(l.unit_price)::text as unit_price, trim_scale(l.amt)::text as amt, l.due_date, l.line_status, trim_scale(pr.qty)::text as promised_qty, pr.first_date as promised_first, pr.last_date as promised_last from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id
left join lateral (select sum(al.promised_qty) as qty, min(al.promised_date) as first_date, max(al.promised_date) as last_date from srm_po_ack_line al where al.ack_id = va.ack_id and al.po_line_id = l.po_line_id) pr on true where l.po_id = #{poId} and p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.issued_at is not null order by l.line_no

select a.ack_id, a.ack_seq, a.rev, a.source, a.ack_status, a.reject_reason, a.ack_by_nm, a.ack_on, a.remark, a.created_at, (a.rev = p.rev and a.ack_seq = (select max(x.ack_seq) from srm_po_ack x where x.po_id = p.po_id and x.rev = p.rev)) as valid, a.rev < p.rev as old_rev from srm_po_ack a join srm_po p on p.po_id = a.po_id where a.po_id = #{poId} and p.cust_id = #{custId} order by a.ack_seq desc

select al.ack_id, al.po_line_id, l.line_no, i.item_cd, al.promised_date, trim_scale(al.promised_qty)::text as promised_qty, al.remark from srm_po_ack_line al join srm_po_ack a on a.ack_id = al.ack_id join srm_po p on p.po_id = a.po_id join srm_po_line l on l.po_line_id = al.po_line_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where a.po_id = #{poId} and p.cust_id = #{custId} order by a.ack_seq desc, l.line_no, al.promised_date
select po_id from srm_po where po_id = #{poId} and cust_id = #{custId} and issued_at is not null for update
mapper.sql: a.asn_id, a.asn_no, a.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm, a.ship_date, a.eta_date, a.supplier_ref, a.carrier_memo, a.source, a.status, a.sent_at, a.cancel_reason, a.remark, a.row_ver, (select count(*) from srm_asn_line l where l.asn_id = a.asn_id)::int as line_cnt, a.open_line_cnt
mapper.select: select from srm_asn a left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = a.plant_cd where a.cust_id = #{custId} and a.ship_date <= #{to} and a.eta_date >= #{from} and a.status = #{status} and (a.asn_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or a.supplier_ref ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\') order by a.eta_date desc, a.asn_id desc limit 500

select l.line_no, l.po_line_id, p.po_no, pl.line_no as po_line_no, i.item_cd, pl.item_nm, l.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, trim_scale(coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = l.asn_line_id), 0))::text as recv_qty, l.supplier_lot_no, l.mfg_date, l.expiry_date, l.pack_cnt, l.remark from srm_asn_line l join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = l.asn_id join srm_po_line pl on pl.po_line_id = l.po_line_id join srm_po p on p.po_id = pl.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.asn_id = #{asnId} and a.cust_id = #{custId} order by l.line_no
select asn_id, source, status from srm_asn where asn_id = #{asnId} and cust_id = #{custId} for update

select distinct p.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm from srm_po p left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = p.plant_cd where p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.source = 'SRM' and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') order by p.plant_cd

select y.po_line_id, y.po_no, y.line_no, y.item_cd, y.item_nm, y.unit_cd, trim_scale(y.open_qty)::text as open_qty, trim_scale(y.notified)::text as notified_qty, trim_scale(greatest(y.room - y.notified, 0))::text as notifiable_qty, y.due_date from (select l.po_line_id, p.po_no, l.line_no, i.item_cd, l.item_nm, l.unit_cd, l.due_date, l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty as open_qty, (l.qty - l.cancel_qty) * (100 + hb_srm_recv_over_pct(p.comp_cd, p.plant_cd)) / 100 - l.recv_qty as room, coalesce((select sum(greatest(al.qty - coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = al.asn_line_id), 0), 0)) from srm_asn_line al join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = al.asn_id where al.po_line_id = l.po_line_id and a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and a.asn_id <> #{asnId}), 0) as notified from srm_po p join srm_po_line l on l.po_id = p.po_id and l.line_status = 'OPEN' join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and p.source = 'SRM' and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty > 0) y order by y.due_date, y.po_no, y.line_no limit 500
mapper.sql: k.claim_id, k.claim_no, k.action_cd, k.title, k.request_text, k.reply_due, trim_scale(k.charge_amt)::text as charge_amt, k.currency_cd, k.status, k.sent_at, k.answer_cause, k.answer_action, k.answered_on, k.answer_source, k.closed_at, k.cancel_reason, k.row_ver, (select count(*) from srm_claim_ncr n where n.claim_id = k.claim_id)::int as ncr_cnt
mapper.select: select from srm_claim k where k.claim_id = #{claimId} and k.cust_id = #{custId} and k.sent_at is not null

select n.ncr_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(n.nc_qty)::text as nc_qty, n.unit_cd from srm_claim_ncr n join srm_claim k on k.claim_id = n.claim_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id where n.claim_id = #{claimId} and k.cust_id = #{custId} and k.sent_at is not null order by n.claim_ncr_id
select claim_id from srm_claim where claim_id = #{claimId} and cust_id = #{custId} and sent_at is not null for update
